=== ===
 
This opening was used in certain episodes of Pokémon: Adventures in the Orange Islands on Pokémon TV. It was first used in the redub of In The Pink, and was subsequently used with the original dub of The Pokémon Water War, Pokémon Food Fight!, Pokémon Double Trouble, Viva Las Lapras, and The Underground Round Up. In all other episodes from The Wacky Watcher! to The Rivalry Revival, the English version of the song was used instead.
